WoWFA Forever 1.0.0-beta.1 - the first public version (beta).

Persian for WoW Forever (game build 1.60.1.71037): quests (window, quest list beside the map, tracker), NPC names (nameplates, target, tooltips), zone names (map, minimap, arrival), spells and talents (names and descriptions), red alerts, system chat lines, chat bubbles, flight masters. Persian font, right-to-left shaping, Persian digits.

Settings (/wowfa or the minimap icon): every surface can be switched, presets and profiles, share codes, colours, and one Font sizes page where each slider moves one group of texts (addon texts, quest list and tracker, game texts, chat, red alerts, settings window).

Since rc35 (pre-release review): the tracker never restores Persian as English; no tracker writes in combat; the quest list title switch also works on the classic list; profiles keep the Persian font and Persian chat switches and apply the window scale at once; reused chat bubbles no longer shrink; talent tooltips follow the Talents switch; the zone arrival mode switch restores at once; long sessions no longer grow memory.

Report a wrong NPC name with /wowfa target. Beta: please report anything that looks wrong.

Data from ForeverDB.net
